# vappcloud_cloud_sizes (Data Source)

Reads VAppCloud catalog entries from `/v1/cloud/sizes`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vappcloud_cloud_sizes" "all" {
  cloud_connection_id = "cloud_connection_example"
  region              = "us-east-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `application_id` (String)
- `cloud_connection_id` (String)
- `github_connection_id` (String)
- `project_id` (String)
- `region` (String)

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `metadata_json` (String, Sensitive) Canonical catalog metadata. Marked sensitive because provider-defined metadata is not schema-constrained.
- `name` (String)
- `state` (String)
